notes.changelog: v0.3 (2026-04-06): Added provenance metadata to all 198 nodes and 264 edges; introduced provenance_sources registry; mapped nodes to SemiKong, MatKG, SemicONTO, BIS CCL, JEDEC, IRDS, FMEA-KG framework, Wikidata, tibonto/dr, Korea NCT; identified author-defined nodes requiring expert validation | v0.2 (2026-02-11): Expanded FailureMode (7→25), RootCause (5→20), Mitigation (5→20), causal edges (9→80+) | v0.1: Added 42 Equipment nodes, 10 Vendors, 2 EquipmentClasses on 2026-02-09
notes.methodology: Each node is mapped to its closest public source. Interpretation levels: 'verbatim' (directly from source), 'mapped' (concept exists but renamed/restructured), 'author-defined' (no public source, researcher judgment). Author-defined items are the focus of expert validation, reducing review scope from 198 full nodes to ~40-50 targeted items.
